name: VAG DQ200 / 0AM (0CW) 7-speed dry DSG mechatronic

read_methods.notes: No open source documents a read path or flash layout for DQ200 software. Factory flash containers are VAG FRF/ODX files using the method 0x11 table cipher + compression (vag-tcu-tools); OpenTune does not decode them for DQ200 yet.

notes: Seven-speed dry-clutch DSG (0AM, later 0CW), 200 Nm class, mechatronic inside the gearbox. Identify only: no DQ200 read was available, so no definition, checksum or maps are claimed; opentune-scan recognises 0AM/0CW part numbers in an image as DQ200 (medium tier). Vehicle list per the cited listing (not exhaustive). No pinout is given: no open source with a pin-level drawing for this unit was found, so none is guessed.
